source: Martinez et al. (2021), ApJ 916, 60, Table 4, power-law limb darkening of the star from the ROTIR fit to the CHARA/MIRC nights of 2010 and 2011 (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-4357/ac06a5)
band: CHARA/MIRC H band, 1.5-1.7 um; not a visible band
note: I(mu)/I(1) = mu^alpha, the Hestroffer (1997) power law the paper fits. Its uncertainty is the paper's bootstrap. Parks et al. (2021), ApJ 913, 54, give 0.229 ± 0.111 from the same nights. The visible limb is not measured.
